d: Short cropped ash grey hair with a rugged, swept-back style and a coarse texture. Narrow keen amber orange eyes with a stern, focused expression. Apparent age of thirty-five with a weathered, rugged maturity. Broad-shouldered, muscular build. A heavy dark brown leather gambeson with iron shoulder pauldrons and a deep forest green cloak. A wide leather belt with a heavy iron buckle and a weathered silver ring on the right index finger.
